# Vantage Rock Financial

> Fractional CFO. AI-native financial leadership. The single public offer is a 30-minute Finance Systems Review — a fit-check. We don't diagnose on the call.

Vantage Rock Financial is AI-enabled finance. Not a chatbot on last month's file. Most shops calling it that are running a prompt on a spreadsheet nobody trusts. This is a fractional CFO firm. Human on the decisions. System on the rest.

## Locked facts

- 30-minute Finance Systems Review: a fit-check. We cover where the finance function is now and what's slow. We don't diagnose on the call and you don't leave with a plan. Fit or not, you leave knowing whether there's work here worth doing.
- The Review is not a diagnostic. A short diagnostic follows only if it's a fit, then the engagement scoped from it. Fees are scoped, never listed, because they move with entity count, systems, and how much needs rebuilding rather than running.
- Three pillars:
  - AI-enabled finance — a function that can actually lead. Not a dashboard with a prompt box.
  - AI-native financial leadership — humans on the decisions, systems on the rest. We build finance systems that think.
  - Fractional CFO Services, AI-Enabled Finance, and AI-Native Financial Leadership are three angles on one engagement, not separate products. The 30-minute Finance Systems Review is the only public door.
- SCORECARD is a high-ticket sample, not a form and not an email subject. Want more on SCORECARD? Get in touch at info@vantagerockfinancial.com. Seven areas: close and accuracy, cash and treasury, forecasting, profitability, KPIs and reporting, process and controls, automation.
- Founder: Stavros Christias. Finance and operations, 10+ years across healthcare, technology, startups, and PE-backed shops. You talk to the operator.
- Who: founder-led and sponsor-backed companies from $1M in revenue, typically alongside an existing bookkeeper or controller. Strongest in healthcare, professional services, technology and SaaS, and multi-entity groups.
- Email: info@vantagerockfinancial.com
- Site: https://www.vantagerockfinancial.com
- Agents we've built (not five SKUs, no list prices):
  - Month-End Close Agent — What's holding up the close, and how much can we run without the team touching it? Accruals, recons, JEs.
  - Cashflow Agent — Who owes us, which invoices are about to slip, what have we done. AR traceable to a datapoint.
  - Expense Agent — Which costs are trending up, and why the line moved.
  - Flux Analysis Agent — What changed in the P&L vs last period, why, is it a problem. Learns from corrections.
  - Daily Brief Agent — What's on the plate today. CRM, email, calendar, Slack, trackers. Walk in prepared.
